summary: Full end-to-end testing of VisaScout (backend + frontend). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass, including a real async live web search (Claude Sonnet 5 + Anthropic hosted web_search) that returned a valid India→Japan tourism JSON with the 5 checklist categories and 11 real official sources in ~50s. PDF export returned a valid %PDF file (>1KB). Notify correctly returns HTTP 503 (RESEND_API_KEY intentionally empty). Rerun sets status to processing. Frontend: login (demo) → disclaimer gate → dashboard → new lookup → processing-state (data-testid processing-state) → real result rendered in 63s with visa-category, requirements-summary, all 5 collapsible checklist cards, processing-card, fee-card, portal-link, sources-panel with 11 sources, 'Consult a professional' warning banner where appropriate. PDF download works. Notify button surfaces the expected 'not configured' toast. Settings notify-switch toggles both ways. Delete removes a card. No blocking bugs found.

issues: Card footer has 'mt-auto pt-4 ... mt-4' (duplicate mt-4 class in Dashboard.jsx L108) — harmless but style hygiene.

action_items: None blocking. Minor: dedupe duplicate 'mt-4' Tailwind class on Dashboard card footer (Dashboard.jsx L108). Optional: provide RESEND_API_KEY when the user is ready — notify path is otherwise wired correctly and gracefully surfaces the 503 as a toast.
critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute uses `window.location.pathname` for the disclaimer gate check — fine in practice but React Router's `useLocation()` would be more idiomatic and SSR-safe.

Backend `_process_lookup` background task swallows exceptions and stores `error` on the doc — good. But `asyncio.create_task` isn't retained, so if the process is restarted mid-flight the search stays 'processing' forever. Consider a TTL / heartbeat or a status watchdog.
`/api/purposes` is unauthenticated — fine, but not exposed under auth in tests either (matches implementation).
`bcrypt` password hashes verified in bcrypt-standard $2b$ format via `hash_password`/`verify_password`.
MongoDB `_id` is correctly excluded on every read using `{'_id': 0}` projection or `doc.pop('_id', None)` — no ObjectId leak observed.
Duplicate `mt-4` class in Dashboard.jsx L108 (`mt-auto pt-4 ... mt-4`) is a small hygiene issue.
Live-search result also includes `application_portal_url` (rendered as portal-link) — verified end-to-end for India→Japan (vfsglobal one-pager).
Guardrails present: warning-banner correctly rendered when `consult_professional` / `ambiguous` / `found_reliable_source === false`.
seed_data_creation: None — used the seeded demo account. New test users are created with @example.com and cleaned up only implicitly by DB rebuild.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover auth, purposes, async visa lookup (with polling up to 180s), list/get/rerun/delete/PDF/notify. Run with: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest tests/backend_test.py -v`. Live lookup takes ~40-90s. Pydantic EmailStr rejects `.test` TLD — use `@example.com` for test users. Frontend disclaimer gate uses `window.location.pathname` — after login the URL briefly reads /app before redirecting to /disclaimer; wait ~1s before asserting. Demo user's seen_disclaimer is reset on every new DB (seed only inserts if missing).
